cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && set -o pipefail && .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
base='bench/results/environment-narration/shadow-sample/full'
rows=json.load(open(base+'/rows/rows.json'))
summary=json.load(open(base+'/rows/summary.json'))
assert rows, 'no rows'
turns=[t for r in rows for t in r.get('turns',[])]
assert turns, 'no turns'
assert summary.get('shadow') is True, 'shadow not on'
print('replicates',len(rows),'turns',len(turns),'calls',summary['calls_made'],'stopped',summary['stopped_reason'],'errors',summary['errors'],'observation_turns',summary.get('observation_turns'),'verifier_requests',summary.get('shadow_verifier_requests'))
spent=json.load(open(base+'/spent.json'))
print('spent',spent)
assert spent['spent_micro_usd']<=250000, 'cap exceeded'
PY
(set -a; . ./.env; set +a; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os
base='bench/results/environment-narration/shadow-sample/full'
text=''.join(open(os.path.join(d,f)).read() for d,_,fs in os.walk(base) for f in fs)
for name in ('CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN','CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID','CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN'):
    v=os.environ.get(name,'').strip()
    assert not v or v not in text, name+' value leaked into outputs'
print('no credential in outputs')
PY
)
